summary: Frontend-only verification of the new real-time SSE token streaming UX + tiered model picker in /app/code IDE. Reused existing 'Stream Test' react-vite project (sandbox already ready) per test hint. All acceptance criteria PASSED using model GPT-5.6 Terra.
ai_feature_verdicts: model_picker_tier_grouping - pass - Opening [data-testid=agent-model-picker] shows headers FAST / MEDIUM / SLOW with these entries: FAST=[DeepSeek V3, GPT-4o mini], MEDIUM=[GPT-5.6 Terra, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Qwen2.5 Coder], SLOW=[Claude Sonnet 4.6]. Each entry has a colored tier pill. All 6 models required by the problem statement are listed (Qwen2.5 Coder is an additional model beyond the 5 in the request — not a bug).
ide_testids_present - pass - tab-code, tab-preview, tab-terminal, files-panel, agent-input, agent-send, agent-model-picker all FOUND.

live_streaming_indicator - pass - After clicking agent-send, the last assistant message showed the pulsing dot (.animate-ping) with the current action text ('Scanned project' → 'Read src/App.jsx' → 'Edited src/App.jsx'). Blinking caret element (.animate-pulse on 1.5x4 primary span) was present during streaming. Once the run finished, the pulsing indicator was replaced with a 'SUMMARY' section containing bullet points ('- Changed the heading in `App.jsx` to "Hello Arevei".', '- Added a short paragraph to enhance the description.').
step_chips - pass - Step chips visible in assistant message: 'Scanned project', 'Read src/App.jsx', 'Edited src/App.jsx' — matches list_files/read_file/write_file tool events from the SSE stream.

monaco_and_files_reflect_edit - pass - After run, Monaco editor showed

Hello Arevei

and the added paragraph in src/App.jsx (verified via .monaco-editor .view-line innerText). Files panel still lists src/App.jsx, src/index.css, src/main.jsx, index.html, package.json, vite.config.js. (Note: my substring assertion for 'Hello Arevei' technically returned False because Monaco splits identifiers across spans with non-standard whitespace, but the rendered text and screenshot clearly show it correct.)

streaming_speed_note - info - Full agent run completed in ~4 seconds with GPT-5.6 Terra (very fast). text_delta events were consumed but the run was too short to visually observe long incremental token append; the pulsing dot + caret + step chips all rendered correctly regardless.

issues: Prior failed turns (from previous OpenRouter 402 tests) are still displayed as messages showing raw error JSON e.g. 'Error: Error code: 402 - {\'error\': ...}'. Cosmetic only — the feature works — but consider rendering these as a friendlier styled error banner instead of raw exception text.

critical_code_review_comments: CodeWorkspace.send(): the SSE parser splits on '\n\n' and takes the first line starting with 'data: '. This assumes each event has a single data line and no comment/keep-alive lines — fine for current backend but fragile if backend later adds 'event:' or heartbeat ':ping' frames.

AgentMessage: while working, the assistant's streamed text_delta content is shown with muted-foreground styling; once 'summary' arrives, the whole content is replaced by the summary text. Good, but any text_delta content emitted BEFORE tool calls is lost when summary replaces it. Acceptable trade-off but worth noting.
CodeWorkspace.send(): when 'file' event arrives, only the currently open file is re-opened; other opened tabs are not refreshed (there is only one active file though). Fine.

Agent input allows Enter to send even while streaming=true? send() early-returns if streaming, but the textarea remains enabled. Minor UX polish: disable textarea while streaming or show a stop button.
Model picker dropdown lists Qwen2.5 Coder which is not mentioned in the problem statement's list of new models — verify this is intentional.
